name: Paxton Legal Research
description:
Turn a legal research question into authorities you can inspect. Use Paxton in Claude to search U.S. statutes, regulations, rules, case law, and indexed EEOC and NLRB decisions. Open source links, retrieve full source text, and inspect case citation relationships and available status information.

Start with a jurisdiction and a specific question. Ask Claude to find relevant authorities, read the supporting passages, and distinguish holdings from arguments or quoted material. Follow the citations to review the source yourself.

Already a Paxton customer? Connect and sign in with your Paxton account. MCP is included without a separate MCP fee and uses your existing account and organization access. New to Paxton? Get started at https://app.paxton.ai/sign-up, then connect after your account has legal research access. Claude workspace administrators may need to enable the connector.

This connector is read-only: it searches legal sources, not your private matter files, and cannot edit or upload documents. Legal research requires professional review. Search results and citation relationships do not establish that an authority is controlling, current, or sufficient for a legal proposition.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Paxton Legal Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Paxton Legal Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://paxton-mcp-connector-xmfvvq3waa-uc.a.run.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Paxton Legal Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paxton Legal Research provides these MCP tools: get_citator_info, get_source_text, search_administrative_decisions, search_case_law, and search_legal_research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Paxton Legal Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Paxton Legal Research in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Paxton Legal Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paxton Legal Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Paxton Legal Research is developed by Paxton. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
